AL_basis: Estimate from TDK EELP22 0.10 mm total-gap table; two 0.05 mm gapped halves. This is NOT the 1520 nH one-gapped/one-ungapped combination. Pair AL has no purchased tolerance guarantee.
Lm_acceptance_note: Measure after clipping at 10 kHz, low signal, secondary open. Reject/re-pair outside this range; do not grind or add shims. Screen bias separately on first articles.
flux_screen_basis: Below 90% of TDK core table 0.300 T at 100 C, H=250 A/m. This is a screening bound, not a nonlinear saturation or overload guarantee. Typical 7.2 A restart excursions need bench verification.
clip_projection_note: Conservative acceptance envelope beyond maximum ferrite edge. TDK source core/free-clip STEP models are included. Installed opening is a geometric surrogate, not a spring-force simulation; verify physical engagement and retention.
process: Install two factory-gapped halves and two matching clips after PCBA. No ferrite machining, adhesive, activator, strap or shim. Center temporarily for inspection; clips retain the pair, and the core can float within PCB clearance.
